meta.title: perf: Optimize getSlots function to handle large dateRanges arrays efficiently
meta.body_summary: Optimize getSlots function to process hundreds of date ranges in ~70ms instead of ~6s by replacing O(n²) nested loops with a Set-based lookup and skipping duplicate slots.

perf_labels.notes: Devin delivered an algorithm optimization with a self-contained performance test; a minor test threshold was tightened per review and the PR merged in ~1 hour.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 142 changed lines in two files, this is a small, tightly scoped edit. It fits a classic small-step performance PR that merged quickly after a trivial test adjustment.

review_details.concern_detail: Reviewer keithwillcode suggested lowering the performance assertion from <6s to <1s to ensure the optimization meets practical expectations.
review_details.performance_claim: Reduced getSlots execution time from ~6s to ~70ms for 288 date ranges (85x faster).

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Algorithmic optimization within a single utility function is within Devin's capability; merge was unblocked by a small, non-binding review suggestion that was immediately incorporated.

detection_detail.code_reading: keithwillcode reviewed the test assertion and requested a tighter threshold (1s instead of 6s).
detection_detail.ci_auto: github-actions provided E2E test results, but performance validation relied on the unit-level timing test.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: The PR adds a performance test that measures execution time with 2000 date ranges, making the speedup independently verifiable.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After review, two follow-up commits lowered the test threshold from 6s to 1s and increased the input size to 2000 date ranges, ensuring stricter performance validation.

core_change_summary.description: In packages/lib/slots.ts, replaced nested loops with a Set-based lookup to skip duplicates and optimized slot boundary checks; added a performance test in slots.test.ts that processes up to 2000 date ranges and asserts execution time under 1 second.
change_trajectory: Initial commit (45bb78e): refactored getSlots algorithm and added a performance test with 500 date ranges, asserting <6s.
Review inline comment (keithwillcode): suggested lowering threshold to <1s; commit 33f9737 adopted the change.
Devin follow-up commits: increased test data to 2000 date ranges across multiple days to stress the function further.
PR merged after APPROVED review by emrysal.

review_signals.action_taken: Devin applied the suggestion and later extended the test to use 2000 date ranges.
